finding_C.defect_closed: the adopted general authority law (pre553_empirical_authority._scope_contains) recognizes BOTH EXPLICIT_UNRESTRICTED and UNRESTRICTED_BY_THIS_AUTHORITY as positive blanket scope. F7's three local scope helpers recognized only EXPLICIT_UNRESTRICTED, so a competent authority expressed with the other adopted representation was silently reinterpreted as non-authority. This was fail-closed rather than fail-open, but it could reject a competent authority representation existing law explicitly accepts.
finding_C.inspection_result: Both tokens ARE valid current representations in the adopted general law, so per the commission F7 must honour both exactly.

repair.omission_proof: the helpers still return False for None, empty collections, empty string, and any other literal; only the two exact adopted literals grant a blanket

finding_D.defect_closed: HQ219's RR-03 targeted break was not a targeted break. It observed an unsatisfied-owner refusal, monkeypatched only exact-ref coverage, and then constructed a SEPARATE satisfied owner registry. It never disabled owner-satisfaction consultation on the same fixture, so it could not demonstrate fail capability.
finding_D.disclosure: The RR-03 witness cannot execute against pre-repair production because the seam it breaks does not exist there (monkeypatch raises AttributeError). Its pre-repair discriminating power is instead carried by the three RR-03B scope witnesses in artifact 02, all of which DO fail pre-repair. Disclosed rather than hidden.

repair.mechanism: ONE fixture: _full_registry(te_identity_satisfied=False), where the adopted owner says the identity surface is NOT satisfied. The break falsifies only the owner's satisfaction verdict on that same fixture.
repair.production_seam_added: _temporal_evidence_identity_scope(snapshot) - the single point through which F7 reads the adopted TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority about temporal identity. It performs no new adjudication; it only makes the owner consultation breakable on ONE fixed fixture.
repair.result: flips to TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED; restoring the real consultation restores TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED with reason IDENTITY_SURFACE_NOT_JOINTLY_SATISFIED

rr04_targeted_break_also_rewritten.new_mechanism: falsify the owner's REAL returned verdict on the same DENIED fixture using dataclasses.replace on the genuine RelationDecision, changing only state/authority. The forged-impostor case is split into its own hardening witness.
rr04_targeted_break_also_rewritten.reason: HQ219's RR-04 break patched require() with a NON-RETURNING fake. Post-repair F7 validates the returned proof, so that fake is now refused - the old assertion (the break must reopen the gap) had come to assert the very vulnerability the repair closes.
